name: Hive 1.5.13
notes: Two quality-of-life fixes. The chat transcript now offers a jump-to-latest button any time you're scrolled up, not only when new messages arrived — so re-reading something no longer means scrolling all the way back by hand. The Review inbox is ordered newest-first with work that still needs a decision on top, and settled proposals can be dismissed (individually or with 'Clear settled') instead of accumulating in the pane forever. Dismissing hides, never deletes: the record stays in the session log and dismissed items remain reachable.
